about.title: About Us
about.tagline: Preserving the soul of Vedic traditions. We bridge the distance between you and the divine through authentic heritage services, bringing ancient rituals to the modern world.
about.mission_desc1: At Shyampuja, our mission is to make spiritual services accessible, transparent, and authentic for everyone, everywhere. We believe that distance should never be a barrier to devotion.
about.mission_desc2: We are dedicated to supporting ancient temples and Vedic pandits by connecting them with devotees worldwide, ensuring that our rich cultural heritage continues to thrive in the digital age.
about.authenticity_desc: We partner only with verified temples and experienced Vedic pandits to ensure every ritual is performed with strict adherence to scriptures.
about.transparency_desc: We believe in complete transparency. From booking to darshan, you will know exactly what service is being performed and where your dakshina is going.
about.devotion_desc: Every service we offer is curated with deep respect and devotion. We treat your spiritual needs with the same care as our own.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro_p1: Welcome to Shyampuja. We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. This privacy policy will inform you as to how we look after your personal data when you visit our website and tell you about your privacy rights and how the law protects you.
privacy.intro_p2: By using our services, you agree to the collection and use of information in accordance with this policy. We use your data to provide and improve the Service.
privacy.collect_p1: We collect several different types of information for various purposes to provide and improve our Service to you:
privacy.collect_li1: Personal Data: Email address, first and last name, phone number, and address for booking and billing purposes.
privacy.collect_li2: Payment Information: When you make a booking, financial information is processed through our payment gateway (e.g., Razorpay). We do not store your full card details on our servers.
privacy.collect_li3: Usage Data: Information on how the Service is accessed and used, including your IP address, browser type, and version.
privacy.security_p: The security of your data is important to us, but remember that no method of transmission over the Internet is 100% secure. While we strive to use commercially acceptable means to protect your Personal Data, including SSL encryption for all transactions, we cannot guarantee its absolute security.
privacy.gateway_p: To provide a secure payment experience, we integrate with trusted payment processors. Your data is handled according to their privacy policies. In compliance with payment gateway standards, we ensure that sensitive information is transmitted securely and is only used for transaction processing and fraud prevention.
privacy.third_party_p: We may employ third-party companies and individuals to facilitate our Service, to provide the Service on our behalf, or to assist us in analyzing how our Service is used. These third parties have access to your Personal Data only to perform these tasks on our behalf and are obligated not to disclose or use it for any other purpose.
privacy.changes_p: We may update our Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new Privacy Policy on this page and updating the Last Updated date at the top.
privacy.contact_text: If you have any questions, contact us at

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.agreement_p: By accessing or using the Shyampuja website, you agree to be bound by these Terms and Conditions. These terms constitute a legally binding agreement between you and Shyampuja regarding your use of our spiritual services and platform.
terms.services_p: We provide a platform for booking specialized spiritual rituals, Poojas, and Pandit services. By booking a service, you agree to the following:
terms.services_li1: All payments must be completed at the time of booking via ours secure payment gateway.
terms.services_li2: Prices listed are inclusive of standard ritual materials unless otherwise specified.
terms.user_resp_li1: You must provide accurate and complete information when booking a service (name, Gotra, location, etc.).
terms.user_resp_li2: Users are responsible for ensuring a proper environment for virtual rituals if they opt for online services.
terms.user_resp_li3: The use of the platform for any illegal or unauthorized purpose is strictly prohibited.
terms.liability_p: Shyampuja acts as a facilitator between devotees and spiritual experts. While we ensure high standards of service, we shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages resulting from the ritual performance or any technical issues during virtual sessions.
terms.ip_p: All content, including text, designs, graphics, and mantras shared through our platform, remains the intellectual property of Shyampuja and is protected by copyright laws. Unauthorized reproduction is strictly prohibited.
terms.consent_text: By continuing to use our platform, you acknowledge that you have read and understood these terms.

refund.title: Refund & Cancellation
refund.intro_p: At Shyampuja, we strive to provide the most authentic spiritual experience. We understand that plans can change, and we have established the following refund and cancellation policy for our divine services.
refund.cancellation_p: You can cancel your booking through your user dashboard or by contacting our support team.
refund.can_li1: Cancellations made more than 48 hours before the scheduled ritual will be eligible for a full refund minus a 5% processing fee.
refund.can_li2: Cancellations made between 24 and 48 hours before the ritual will be eligible for a 50% refund.
refund.can_li3: Cancellations made less than 24 hours before the ritual are not eligible for a refund, as arrangements with the temple and pandits would have already been finalized.
refund.refund_p: Once a refund is approved, it will be processed through the original payment method (e.g., Razorpay) within 5-7 business days.
refund.exceptions_p: In the rare event that a ritual cannot be performed due to technical issues on our end or temple-side emergencies, a full refund will be provided or the ritual will be rescheduled at your convenience.
refund.contact_text: For any refund-related queries, please write to us at

contact_page.q1: How do I book a personalized pooja?
contact_page.a1: You can select the desired pooja from our listing and complete the payment. After booking, our team will contact you for your Gotra and other details.
contact_page.a2: Yes, all rituals are performed by certified pandits at the specified temples. You will receive a video/photo proof of the ceremony.
contact_page.q3: Can I have multiple family members in a pooja?
contact_page.a3: Most poojas allow including names of immediate family members. Please specify the details during the post-booking consultation.
